validation_rules.name: Prevent_Circular_Parent_Case
validation_rules.formula:
AND(
    NOT(ISBLANK(ParentId)),
    OR(
        AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ParentId = Id),
        AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Parent.ParentId)), Parent.ParentId = Id)
    )
)
validation_rules.message: A case cannot be the parent of itself, and two cases cannot be parents of each other.
